POL-NS-06 governs the consequence: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The pickup is a STANDARD zone (minimum 300 seconds), the effective continuous dwell is 220.0 seconds, and the rider filed this dispute, so the whole contested SGD 4.00 must come back to the rider. This rests on the impaired trace EV-GPS-00211 (weight 0.39, GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) for the dwell figure, and on the clean trip record EV-TRIP-00211 and fare record EV-FARE-00211 (both weight 1.0) for the zone class and the fee actually charged.

ledger.claim: The 'longest_qualifying_run' figure of 500.0 seconds in this same artifact does not show a continuous dwell and cannot carry the driver's case. It runs from 12:30:00 to 12:38:20 and straddles the 168-second outage from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28; the artifact's own run list splits the driver's 35 qualifying fixes into two runs of 220.0 and 112.0 seconds and its shortfall is assessed on the longest run, not on the span. POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous dwell, and a span containing an unmeasured interval is not a continuous dwell. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired (weight 0.39, GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) and I disclose that in relying on its run structure.

The 168-second outage cannot be credited to the driver as dwell, so it cannot close the 80-second shortfall. The pre-pass records that 'whether he stayed put across those 168 seconds is not established by this trace', and POL-NS-02's treatment of fixes that do not qualify for the proximity test is that they count as evidence of neither presence nor absence. Unmeasured time is therefore neutral and cannot be added in the driver's favour, and his assertion that he was outside Blk 79 'the whole time' is unsupported by the trace across the very interval in dispute. Relies on EV-GPS-00211, impaired at 0.39 with issues GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

The driver's assertion that 'nobody came down' is contradicted by the record. The rider's track runs from 12:30:00 to 12:40:00 with 36 of 55 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (mean distance 81.8 m, closest fix 24.6 m), and at 12:31:02 she messaged 'coming down now, 2 min', which the driver read and answered 'ok waiting outside 79' at 12:31:20. She was on site and on her way down. I cite POL-NS-04 only for the presence radius that fixes this location test; the rider does not seek exoneration under POL-NS-04 itself, because the driver did reply within 120 seconds. Rider presence here rests on the impaired trace EV-GPS-00211 (weight 0.39, GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) and is corroborated by the clean chat log EV-CHAT-00211 (weight 1.0).

No driver compensation arises on this trip. POL-NS-07 applies only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', and POL-NS-01 fails at limb (c) here, so the 80 percent compensation figure is not engaged; POL-NS-06 confirms that where the waiting-period shortfall stands, no driver compensation is payable. The rider's SGD 4.00 refund is therefore the whole of the money this case moves and is not netted against any payment to the driver. Relies on EV-GPS-00211 (impaired, weight 0.39, GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) for the shortfall and on the clean fare record EV-FARE-00211 (weight 1.0) for the amount.

Limb (b) is satisfied to the resolution of the trace. The arrival block counts 35 qualifying in-geofence fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the driver track's minimum distance from the pin is 18.1 m. dwell_start_offset_sec of -5.0 places the first qualifying in-geofence fix half of one 10-second sampling interval after the 12:29:55 arrived event — a sub-interval offset that neither POL-NS-05's false-marker test (300 m / 15 km/h) nor POL-NS-08(a)'s 90-second skew threshold treats as a discrepancy, and which no fix in the trace contradicts. EV-GPS-00211 is IMPAIRED — issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39 — and I rely on it with that discount disclosed.

Limb (c) is met on the arrival block's own measurement of qualifying presence: longest_qualifying_run runs from 12:30:00 to 12:38:20, 500 seconds across 35 qualifying fixes, against a STANDARD minimum of 300 seconds. The shorter 220-second figure in the same block is not a competing dwell — it is what remains when the 168-second outage slices the fixes in two (220 s and 112 s). No fix anywhere in the trace puts the driver outside the radius: max_excursion_m is null and the single entry under excursions carries fix_count 0 and a null max_distance_m. A hole in the data is not a recorded departure, so the split is an artefact of the outage rather than evidence the driver left. Same artifact, same impairment: GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39.

The only unimpaired evidence that speaks to the 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 outage shows the driver still working the pickup through it: MSG-00211-004, sent at 12:35:10 from inside the gap, reads 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', was delivered at 12:35:11 and read by the rider at 12:35:26. The driver's account is corroborated at both ends of the record: the rider wrote 'coming down now, 2 min' at 12:31:02, the driver answered 'ok waiting outside 79' eighteen seconds later, and the trip record's own wait_time_min is 8.4 minutes between the 12:29:55 arrival and the 12:38:20 cancellation — more than four times the rider's own estimate. The marker sits 5 seconds before that first fix: half of one 10-second sampling interval, far short of the 90-second skew POL-NS-08(a) treats as a defect, and the trace nowhere shows the driver 300 m out or at 15 km/h at the marker timestamp. EV-GPS-00211 is IMPAIRED — GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands, and SGD 3.20 of it is paid to the driver as compensation; SGD 0.80 is retained as the platform service fee.

1) The charge is verified on the clean records. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00211, weight 1.0) carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:29:55, no boarding, and a driver-initiated termination at 12:38:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW — POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d). The GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (closest fix 18.1 m; 35 qualifying in-geofence fixes) — limb (b).

2) The contested limb is (c), a continuous 300-second hold. I name the impairment I relied on: EV-GPS-00211 is impaired with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE (a 168-second outage, 12:33:40–12:36:28, inside the waiting window; coverage 84.3%) and carries weight 0.39. On its own it splits the hold into runs of 220 s and 112 s, an 80-second shortfall.

3) The rider's shortfall reading does not carry the case. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00211, weight 1.0, unimpaired) holds a contemporaneous message sent from inside that very outage: at 12:35:10 the driver wrote 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you'. That record lies between the readings the trace admitted and bridges the unmeasured stretch, and the trace nowhere records him leaving the radius (max_excursion_m is null; the excursion entry carries zero fixes). His continuous hold therefore runs from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00 through cancellation at 12:38:20 — 500 seconds — past the 300-second STANDARD minimum. Because the bridging record is independent of the trace, the impaired trace is not the only evidence of the hold: the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is the higher of the two weights (max of 0.39 and 1.0), not the lower, so POL-NS-08's sole-evidence sentence and POL-NS-09(e) do not engage and the 0.70 floor is cleared. Per POL-GEN-02(3) I state that the finding survives the 0.39 discount, because the continuity across the outage is supplied by the bridging chat record rather than by the impaired trace.

4) Consequential points, each answered. The two runs cannot be summed under POL-NS-06(i) without a present, populated traffic advisory, and EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — but no summing is required here, because this is a single bridged hold, not a driver who left and re-entered. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the driver answered her 12:31:02 message at 12:31:20, inside 120 seconds, so the clause does not apply regardless of the reply's content; the rider's presence on her own track is therefore not in issue. POL-NS-03 is not engaged — the qualifying fixes put the driver inside the arrival radius, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 yields no false-arrival referral, since 35 qualifying in-geofence fixes exist and the marker sits half a sampling interval from the first of them. The fare is not defective under POL-NS-08(d): SGD 4.00 is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00). POL-NS-07's anti-farming check passes (no_show_terminations_30d 2, under 4; 2/146 = 1.4%, under 8%), so compensation is paid — and the emitted ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. Profile escalation limbs are not met (no_show_disputes_30d 1; same-party disputes 0), and only the profile fields the policy names have been used. No clause produces a referral, and no open question requires a reviewer.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
